summary: Mobile preview and backend smoke review completed. Home, local-mode indicator, profile creation, profile persistence in UI, profile workshop navigation, microphone permission/recording start, and API-backed startup all worked.

minor.issue: Successful creates return HTTP 200 rather than conventional HTTP 201; not blocking the current frontend flow.

issues: Most interactive controls have no explicit testID/data-testid, which makes robust automated regression testing difficult; only the home screen currently exposes testID.

action_items: Add stable testID values to profile, modal, workshop recording/pause/stop/save/skip, archive filter, and navigation controls.
Consider returning HTTP 201 for successful POST resource creation if API contract requires conventional REST status codes.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in the supplied environment; the review request mentions EXPO_BACKEND_URL, so keep the environment naming contract aligned across deployment configuration.
Expo logs show a non-blocking React Native DevTools electron sandbox warning; Metro still bundles and serves the app successfully.
The preview uses the browser-compatible audio implementation; native microphone behavior still needs a device-level verification for production confidence.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-style functional profile named Jeanne through the UI; it may remain in local/browser and temporary server data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh mobile preview at 390x844 loaded. Home and local mode worked. Profile Jeanne was created, opened, workshop started, and microphone recording reached 'Enregistrement en cours'. Full stop/save/question/archive flow was not completed because browser audio URI persistence requires a longer device-compatible run.
rca_of_issue: No blocking functional issue reproduced. Automated coverage is weakened by absent testIDs: selectors had to rely on exact visible text and button accessibility labels. Backend and frontend logs showed successful residents/questions/capsules requests and no runtime page errors.
